title: Assessment of intrinsic bioremediation of gasoline contamination in the shallow aquifer, Laurel Bay Exchange, Marine Corps Air Station, Beaufort, South Carolina
citation: Landmeyer, J.E., Chapelle, F.H., and Bradley, P.M., 1996, Assessment of intrinsic bioremediation of gasoline contamination in the shallow aquifer, Laurel Bay Exchange, Marine Corps Air Station, Beaufort, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 96-4026, map scale 1:900.
notes:
Hydrogeology/contaminant report for one small site; little stratigraphy. Ground-water chemistry tables (BTEX, MTBE, dissolved oxygen, iron, cations, anions, DIC, methane; tables 1, 3-6) and model simulation figures were not recorded because the schema has no fields for them. Fig. 2 lithologic log (boring near LB-EX-14) has a depth scale 0-15 ft but OCR does not tie descriptions to depths reliably, so intervals are recorded without tops/bottoms. Figs. 3-4 water-table maps: only a few well labels and elevations survive in the text layer; skipped. The report gives slightly different flow rates and gradients on different pages (abstract: about 60 ft/yr and 0.004 ft/ft; p. 10: 0.0046 ft/ft and about 62 ft/yr; p. 12: roughly 70 ft/yr). No pages were image-only.
Re-read of pages 19 and 24-27: Tables 1 and 3-6 (BTEX and MTBE; dissolved oxygen, ferrous iron, sulfide, pH, temperature; cations; anions; dissolved inorganic carbon and methane), all sampled March 11, 1994. One water test per well and constituent. "BD" (below detection limit) results are recorded as printed, with the units of their column; "ND" (no data collected) cells are not recorded. Text values were checked against page images of Tables 1, 3 and 4. Well numbers garbled by OCR (LB-EX^, LB-EX-l, LB-EX-l 1) are flagged inferred; numbers split by a space (LB-EX-1 2) are joined. The table numbers of Tables 4-6 print as "^" in the text layer and are inferred from their order. Plume extents in the p. 19 text are not tests and were not recorded.
